query:
SELECT
            b.brew_hash,
            b.brew_datetime,
            b.grind_setting,
            b.rating,
            cb.bag_hash,
            cb.roaster
           FROM brews b
           LEFT JOIN coffee_bags cb ON b.coffee_bag_id = cb.id
           WHERE b.coffee_bag_id = $2
             AND b.user_id = $1
             AND b.grind_setting IS NOT NULL
           ORDER BY b.brew_datetime ASC
